Austin, US The Texas senator-elect James Talarico and governor-elect Gina Hinojosa, both Democrats, toast with drinks while surrounded by supporters at a Whataburger restaurant. ‘We just took back Texas!’ the 37-year-old Talarico told jubilant supporters at an election night party. ‘We just proved that all the money in the world is no match for the people of Texas. We have just shown that a politics of division is no match for a politics of love.’.

Michigan, US Vehicles go past a billboard featuring US president Donald Trump and a sign referencing gasoline prices, before the midterm elections in Madison Heights. In interviews with the Guardian across the country, voters cited affordability concerns, Trump’s war on Iran and his administration’s aggressive crackdown on immigration as among the main issues that had driven them to cast their votes.

Bakersfield, US A three-year-old girl, whose farmworker mother was arrested by immigration agents days earlier, feeds chickens at her family’s home. Tuesday night’s explosive rout of the Republican party was supercharged by the fury of Hispanic Americans who turned out in record numbers in key battlegrounds to protest against the Trump administration ’s anti-immigrant assault on their communities.

Tehran, Iran Workers install a banner depicting Steve Witkoff, Donald Trump, Benjamin Netanyahu and JD Vance in Tehran. Just hours after the US midterm election results delivered a crushing defeat for the Republican party, pro-regime crowds gathered in Tehran’s Enghelab Square to set fire to the giant banner.
Abu Falah, West Bank Members of the Israeli forces stand next to activists who are assisting Palestinians during the olive harvest in the West Bank village.
Jericho, West Bank Israeli settlers’ children play at a home, into which settlers have moved, in the Israeli-occupied West Bank.
Gaza City, Gaza Children watch a film during a mobile outdoor cinema initiative held as part of the 25th Animation film festival in the Sheikh Radwan neighbourhood of Gaza City.

Kherson, Ukraine A woman, standing in a mobile bomb shelter, waits at a bus station on a road covered with anti-drone nets during a temporary ceasefire. Volodymyr Zelenskyy awarded Melania Trump a national honour for her role in brokering a partial ceasefire that allowed the evacuation of civilians from the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky in Kherson oblast.

Sloviansk, Ukraine An injured woman walks away from a residential building following a Russian airstrike in Sloviansk. Volodymyr Zelenskyy has urged Latin American leaders to help Ukraine obtain urgently needed equipment to repair its power infrastructure damaged by Russian strikes. ‘Every power plant in Ukraine has been damaged in one way or another by attacks,’ the Ukrainian president said at a summit in Madrid on Thursday, adding that repair crews were working around the clock.

Lyon, France Students gather in front of the University of Lyon during a protest demanding more education funding in Lyon. Striking teachers, hospital staff and rail workers joined high school and university students in largely peaceful demonstrations in France on Thursday amid a high police presence of 70,000 officers.

Lyon, France A protester wearing a Marie-Antoinette costume holds a placard reading ‘Give them brioche’ during a demonstration in Lyon. Amid the renewed protests centred on living costs, public spending cuts and the troubled education system, the far-right, anti-immigration presidential candidate Marine Le Pen is polling high for the 2027 election to replace Macron next spring.

Amsterdam, the Netherlands Activists hold flares as they climb a structure during a protest against the construction of a Microsoft datacentre. They are calling for a moratorium on large projects, citing environmental and social costs that ‘we can no longer afford’. In the US midterm elections this week, opponents of datacentres were among the biggest winners for the Democrats.
Rome, Italy A dancer performs in front of police guarding the Italian education ministry, during a nationwide general strike called by grassroots unions in Rome.
Santiago, Chile A police officer tackles a protester as another demonstrator kicks the officer’s helmet during a student protest against government policies in Santiago.

Novi Sad, Serbia People react at the city’s railway station during a commemorative service on the second anniversary of the fatal canopy collapse at the station. Serbian authorities this week detained nine active police officers and one former officer on Wednesday for ⁠allegedly using excessive force against detainees during anti-corruption protests last year in Belgrade, the country’s interior ministry ⁠said.
Moyale, Kenya Members of communities displaced by conflict in southern Ethiopia queue at a registration centre set up by humanitarian agencies at al-Huda primary school.

London, UK Russell Brand arrives at Southwark crown court with his wife, Laura Brand, during the fourth week of his trial on charges of rape and sexual assault. Brand was described during his trial as a ruthless, calculated and manipulative sexual predator . He was convicted of raping a woman at his luxury London townhouse and of sexually assaulting women in front of his entourage at their workplaces, at a radio station and a TV studio.
Catterick, UK Gurkha soldiers check their uniform as they prepare to take part in their pass-out parade at the end of their infantry training at Helles barracks in North Yorkshire.
Masantol, Philippines Filipinos visit the graves of departed loved ones to mark All Saints’ Day at a flooded cemetery.
Activists cling to a tower holding smoke flares beside a "Down with data centres" banner.
Santiago, Chile A police officer tackles a protester as another demonstrator kicks the officer’s helmet during a student protest against government policies in Santiago.
Santiago, Chile Riot police grip a demonstrator during a protest by high school students over education budget cuts.
Lima, Peru A 14m-high statue of Pope Leo XIV, designed by the Peruvian sculptor Rafael Gutierrez, is transported to the port city of Callao before the pope’s pastoral visit to Latin America.
Lewes, England Revellers carry torches through the streets of Lewes during the traditional Bonfire Night celebrations.
Paris, France High school students blockade Rue de Rivoli, one of the main central avenues in Paris, as part of nationwide protests demanding better school conditions.
Dar es Salaam, Tanzania The Tanzanian opposition leader, Tundu Lissu, waves to his supporters as he stands inside the dock at the high court in Dar es Salaam.
Mugla, Turkey Women collect peppers as smoke rises from the thermal power plant in Mugla before the start of Cop31 on Monday.
Ukraine A Russian soldier fires a mortar at an undisclosed location in Ukraine.
Abu Falah, West Bank Israeli soldiers watch activists helping Palestinians with the olive harvest in the West Bank village of Abu Falah.
Los Angeles, California, US Mayor-elect Nithya Raman speaks to the media as she celebrates her election victory in Los Angeles.

Bangkok, Thailand A ceremonial vessel floats down the Chao Phraya River during the Thai royal barge procession for the royal Kathin robe offering ceremony to Buddhist monks at Wat Arun (Temple of Dawn), which marks Queen Suthida’s 48th birthday in June.
Prague, Czechia A runner jogs through a park on a misty autumn morning in Prague.
Dakar, Senegal Bermuda’s Gianluca Bortoli warms up at sunrise before the men’s individual triathlon race at Saly Beach West during the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympics.
Beijing, China A member of staff holds a curtain before the meeting between the Austrian chancellor, Christian Stocker, and the Chinese president, Xi Jinping, at the Great Hall of the People.
A man pushes a burning car during a street protest as crowds watch nearby in Lyon.
Paris, France A high school student plays the flute as fellow pupils stage a sit-in to block a street ahead of a demonstration over education spending and the cost of living.
Lyon, France Students gather in front of the University of Lyon at a protest demanding more education funding.
Lyon, France A car burns during a nationwide day of strikes and protests. Between 500,000 and 700,000 people are expected to take part in about 260 demonstrations on Thursday.
Tehran, Iran Iranians set fire to a banner depicting Steve Witkoff, Donald Trump, Benjamin Netanyahu and JD Vance.
Kyiv, Ukraine Rescuers with fire hoses attend the site of a Russian strike on a civilian warehouse.
Kramatorsk, Ukraine An elderly woman walks past a car destroyed by a Russian air attack on a bridge in the industrial city in eastern Ukraine.
Jericho, West Bank Soldiers walk past settlers preparing to move into homes in Jericho in the occupied West Bank.
Al-Mughayyir, West Bank Palestinians gather olives near Ramallah. The harvest is a major flashpoint between growers and Israeli settlers.
Tebnine, Lebanon Shirin Saad, 19, at the orphanage where she has lived since she was seven. The building was damaged by an Israeli strike in November 2024.
Tebnine, Lebanon Girls from the orphanage line up before boarding a bus to school.

Moyale, Kenya Ethiopian citizens cross into Kenya after fleeing conflict in Moyale, a border town split between the two countries. More than 50,000 people have been displaced by fighting triggered by the raising of a factional flag.

Eneka, Nigeria A man steers a makeshift raft through flood waters using a pole. A humanitarian emergency has been declared after relentless downpours submerged homes and cost the lives of eight children.

Alta, Norway The aurora borealis, or northern lights, lights up the skies over an old fishing boat. The display is caused by collisions between highly charged particles from the sun and gases in the upper atmosphere.
Diamniadio, Senegal Bekir Taşdemir of Turkey competes in the taijiquan (tai chi) event at the 2026 Youth Olympic Games. About 2,700 athletes aged 14 to 17 are taking part.
Antalya, Turkey A newly emerged specimen hangs from a rack at Butterfly World, a climate-controlled conservatory designed to mimic a rainforest.

Glenmoriston, Scotland Beavers swim in the River Ness catchment 500 years after the species was last recorded in the area. Fifteen family groups of beavers will be released there over the next three years.
